rawContent: People are doing the most to cover up for this woman. Surely we can all agree on the basics... she’s an intruder cop who illegally entered someone else’s home and killed them. #BothamShemJean and his loved ones deserve justice. #BlackLivesMatter

Disgusting and predictable. These people love to scapegoat victims and attempt to divert attention with bullshit like this. Well, we’re focused on the facts. A cop trespassed and murdered an unarmed Black person in their own home. #BothamJean #BlackLivesMatter

I was with Ms. Rice yesterday when we found out the cop who killed Tamir Rice was re hired.  There are some things so painful that no one should be forced to re-live. Despite the pain I know we won’t ever stop fighting for justice. #TamirRice #BlackLivesMatter
This past weekend Ms. Rice and I got our history and culture on and visited the Black Smithsonian. Thanks so much for hosting us, @NMAAHC.  #TamirRice #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/EKcVDdUaf1

Seeing Emmet Till’s casket with Ms. Rice was excruciating. We all broke down. The compounding injustices are painful, however we’re also clear that we each must do all we can to ensure another child won’t suffer a similar fate. #TamirRice #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/Mm3OtnV82v

Outraged to hear about the killing of Chinedu Okobi. A Nigerian-American brother, father, son, poet and friend to many I’m close to. He was tased to death by police in Milbrae, CA. We demand accountability and #Justice4Chinedu. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/kZV5YotGMj
